questions.question: Where should the TeX proof live?

options.label: Sandbox only (Recommended)
options.description: Write to ../sandbox/store-axioms-tex/ (source + PDF). No backlog item, trace, CHANGELOG or formal-trace tagging. Matches 'out of curiosity, one-off'; can be promoted later.

options.label: Repo, sdd/formal/tex/
options.description: Committed .tex (PDF gitignored or committed). Requires a BK item, trace, CHANGELOG, README §, and deciding whether check_formal_trace.py should tag it. Maybe 2x the effort.

options.label: Repo, as research appendix
options.description: Commit next to research-store-model-axioms.md as sdd/research/ companion; lighter than formal/ (no @restates tagging) but still BK item + trace.

options.label: Full Lean file (Recommended)
options.description: Axioms, independence table + witnesses (stated), D1, L1–L6, infinite model, infinite upward chain. ~8–12 pages.

options.label: Lemmas only
options.description: Axioms + D1, L1–L6 proofs; skip independence table and the infinite results. ~5–7 pages.

options.label: Plus Alloy summary
options.description: Full scope plus a section explaining what the bounded Alloy checks add (consistency/independence evidence). ~12–15 pages.

questions.question: How much verification of the prose proofs?

options.label: One reviewer pass (Recommended)
options.description: A separate agent compares each TeX proof against its Lean declaration for gaps and statement drift; I fix findings once. Then compile.

options.label: Just compile
options.description: Write and compile only. Cheapest; prose errors possible, Lean remains the authority.

options.label: Review to convergence
options.description: Repeat reviewer passes until a pass finds nothing. Most reliable, highest token cost.

questions.question: Align the TeX body with the spec's Key/key convention?

options.label: Capitalize all (Recommended)
options.description: Every prose 'key'/'keys' in the TeX becomes 'Key'/'Keys' (titles like 'L3, Key injectivity' included), matching spec 051, since the document never means a raw backend key.

options.label: Leave lowercase
options.description: Keep the body as is; only the abstract uses 'Key'. Inconsistent with the spec and with the abstract.
